newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-FEYENOORD ON THE SPOT IN CUP GOAL SPREE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEYENOORD ON THE SPOT IN CUP GOAL SPREE.

text.p: Feyenoord were awarded three penalties on their way to trouncing Jazz Pori of Finland 6-2 in a European Cup preliminary round first-leg match on Wednesday.
Jean Paul van Gastel converted two of the spot kicks but new Argentine signing Julio Ricardo Cruz missed his penalty kick.

The Dutch side were reduced to 10 men just after halftime with the sending-off of Henk Vos, who scored after 22 and 39 minutes, but Pablo Sanchez (58) and Giovanni van Bronckhorst (85) wrapped up victory.
